author: Cptnwhizbang
body:
You need ward, my man!


Pretty much every piece in your main slots will need ward. Gilgamesh is a challenging class in early t10 since you're heavily gear dependant. 


I would recommend finding a better chest, legs, shield to begin. There are a lot of good options, but farming towers to completion is likely out of reach right now.
